🍌 When to plant banana in Nigeria

Also called Ọ̀gẹ̀dẹ̀ wẹ́wẹ́ (Yoruba) and Ayaba (Hausa).

Quick answer: Plant banana in Nigeria from March to May and harvest from all year round. Planted early in the rains; harvested all year after the first 9–12 months.

About banana

Banana bunchy top disease was confirmed in Nigeria in 2012 and threatens banana and plantain.

How to plant banana well

Remove extra suckers, keeping one strong follower per plant.

Planted early in the rains; harvested all year after the first 9–12 months.

Diseases and pests of banana

  • Banana bunchy top virusUproot and destroy infected plants; plant only clean suckers.
  • Black SigatokaRemove infected leaves and use resistant varieties.

Best states for banana

Ogun · Oyo · Osun · Ondo · Delta · Edo · Cross River · Kaduna

Questions farmers ask

When is the best time to plant banana in Nigeria?

Plant banana in Nigeria from March to May and harvest from all year round. Planted early in the rains; harvested all year after the first 9–12 months.

What is banana called in Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo?

Banana is called Ọ̀gẹ̀dẹ̀ wẹ́wẹ́ (Yoruba) and Ayaba (Hausa).

When is banana harvested in Nigeria?

Banana is usually harvested from all year round.

Which Nigerian states grow the most banana?

Ogun, Oyo, Osun, Ondo, Delta, Edo, Cross River and Kaduna are among the best-known banana states.

Can I grow banana in my part of Nigeria?

Banana grows best in the South-West, South-South, South-East, North-Central and North-West regions. In other regions, ask your ADP extension officer before planting.

What diseases attack banana and how do I prevent them?

Banana bunchy top virus: Uproot and destroy infected plants; plant only clean suckers. Black Sigatoka: Remove infected leaves and use resistant varieties.
